hooks.name: Campaign Validate (new file)
hooks.description: Deterministic campaign check when an agent creates a campaign file under campaigns/: state.json schema and bounds, bible and one-shot required sections, dice-log format, session-log headings. Prep, review and README files are skipped by the script.

hooks.name: Campaign Validate (save)
hooks.description: Re-runs the deterministic campaign check every time an agent saves state.json, BIBLE.md, ONESHOT.md, dice-log.jsonl or a session log under campaigns/. Report any FAIL to the user with the fix.
